posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Okay folks, let's see who our next opponent will be.  I'm not sure how Meerkat handled the randomization, but I'll just roll dice - 1d20 each for heroes and villains and 1d12 for the Environment, all listed in set publication order and then alphabetical order (mini-expansions last; 19 and 20 are Mad Bomber Blade and Cosmic Omnitron on the villain roll, while on the hero rolls they get rerolled).  For heroes that have a promo version which I have access to, I'll roll the d12 even/odd, and you get the promo on an odd roll.  (Promos for which I have not seen the incapacitated side are not considered available, which rules out most of them; BGG only has both sides for Young Legacy, Rook City Wraith, Beard Ra, Redeemer Fanatic, and maybe a couple others, but not anything associated with Shattered Timelines.)

Without further ado, we have:

1 - Baron Blade (Advanced)

VS

7 - Tachyon (BlueEyedMeerkat)

15 - Chrono-Ranger (dpt)

1 - Absolute Zero (phantaskippy)

(rolled 1 again, so rerolled) 12 - Mr. Fixer (grysqrl)

11 - Expatriette (Ronway)

IN

4 - Wagner Mars Base

Probably not a very challenging fight, but at least Legacy isn't in it, so it may be somewhat fair.  Step right up, folks...

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Tachyon's player can go ahead and post her opening hand in his initial post.  I'm about to head out for the day, but not before I get this thing rolling.

Round One

Baron Blade - Terralunar Impulsion Beam Inventor

Baron Blade - 40

In Play: Mobile Defense Platform - 10

Trash:

--------------------------------------------------------

Start of Turn: Device activation, T-15, mark....

Play a Card: Hasten Doom.  Each hero takes 2 toxic damage and Blade plays another card.

Backlash Field enters play.

End of Turn: Elemental Redistributor, Devious Disruption ("Bah!  Incompetent minions!  That was critical to my plan!"), and Mobile Defense Platform are discarded.

-------------------------------------------------------

Baron Blade - 40

In Play: Mobile Defense Platform [10], Backlash Field

Trash: Hasten Doom, Elemental Redistributor, Devious Disruption, Mobile Defense Platform.

Effects: ST - Destroy the world if 15 cards are in trash.

ET - Discard the top 3 cards of the villain deck.

If Blade would be destroyed, flip him instead.

Blade is immune to damage (Mobile Defense Platform).

The first time Blade is damaged by a target each turn, Blade deals that target 3 lightning.

Hero HP: Tacky [25], CR [26], AZ [27], Fixer [26], Expat [27]
